consumer.title: 量化交易与技术分析系统

confidence.basis: FT cites three transaction sources, Reuters independently reported the prior bank alert and photographed the Treasury Secretary's yen-purchase note, and official sources confirm the New York Fed-ESF execution mechanism; official size and settlement disclosure remain pending.

window.next_high_information_window: Asia FX, JGB and equity reopen followed by Europe and U.S. cash markets; absent earlier U.S. disclosure, Japan monthly confirmation is scheduled for 28 August at 19:00 JST

verified_facts: The Financial Times reports that the New York Fed sold euros and bought yen on 31 July on behalf of the U.S. Treasury, citing three people familiar with the transaction
Two FT sources said Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley executed the sales; the institutions had not immediately confirmed the transaction or amount

Reuters had already reported that Treasury notified banks to stand ready for possible yen intervention and separately photographed a Treasury Secretary note referring to buying 5 to 10 billion dollars of yen
Official New York Fed and Treasury pages confirm that the New York Fed can execute FX intervention for Treasury's Exchange Stabilization Fund and that ESF assets include euros and yen
FT reports that the dollar fell about 4 percent against the yen on Thursday and another 1.9 percent on Friday to 157.57 yen
Japan's 31 July 19:00 JST official monthly release reports zero intervention for 29 June through 29 July; that period excludes the reported 30-31 July actions and therefore does not disconfirm them
Japan's Ministry of Finance now officially schedules its next monthly release for 28 August at 19:00 JST, covering 30 July through 26 August and therefore including the reported 31 July event

market_confirmation.crypto_source: Binance public spot and USD-M perpetual APIs
market_confirmation.assessment: Crypto spot weakness has broadened and altcoins underperform, while BTC open interest is essentially flat, funding remains positive and USDC plus FDUSD remain stable; this raises downside sensitivity but does not confirm acute cross-asset carry deleveraging or a liquidation cascade.

pending.impact_path: Coordinated yen purchases and intervention expectations -> rapid JPY appreciation and short covering -> contraction of yen-funded carry trades -> equity, credit, high-yield FX and crypto volatility -> BTC open-interest reduction, funding compression and liquidation risk.

scenarios.further_intervention_and_disorderly_yen_: The strongest deleveraging branch requires renewed JPY gains together with higher volatility, weaker global equities and credit, falling BTC open interest, funding compression and rising liquidations.
scenarios.orderly_yen_strength_and_broad_dollar_we: A controlled FX adjustment can reduce dollar pressure and may support some risk assets; do not assume that every yen gain is automatically bearish for BTC.
scenarios.intervention_fades_or_yen_reverses: Carry-unwind risk can recede if USDJPY rebounds without renewed official action and equities, credit and crypto remain orderly.
scenarios.official_denial_or_transaction_reclassif: Downgrade the reported-execution confidence if Treasury or the New York Fed denies intervention or identifies the trades as routine customer activity.
scenarios.monday_cross_asset_gap: Treat Asia, Europe and U.S. cash-market reopenings as separate confirmation windows; price gaps without persistence or volume confirmation are insufficient.

pending.invalidation: Official sources deny intervention or classify the trades as non-intervention activity, USDJPY reverses without renewed action, and JGBs, global equities, credit, BTC open interest, funding and liquidations remain orderly through the Monday reopen.
pending.permitted_use: Raise weekend and Monday-reopen volatility sensitivity and compare JPY, JGBs, global equities, credit and crypto leverage with the scenario tree before updating regime probabilities.
pending.prohibited_use: Do not treat the reported transaction size as official settlement data, infer a fixed BTC direction from yen strength alone, or use this alert to place orders or change position size, leverage, stops or live-trading permissions.

verified_facts: Seven OPEC+ voluntary-adjustment countries will meet on 2 August to review market conditions, conformity and compensation
Their July baseline set a 188 thousand barrels-per-day nominal adjustment for August within the framework for phasing out and returning voluntary cuts
They retained full flexibility to increase, pause or reverse the phase-out of voluntary adjustments
Reuters reported on 23 July that three sources expected another approximately 188 thousand barrels-per-day nominal target increase for September at the 2 August meeting
OPEC's 2 August official release confirms the seven countries decided on a 188 thousand barrels-per-day September production adjustment
The official release reiterates full conformity and compensation for overproduction since January 2024 and sets the next meeting for 6 September 2026

official_outcome.boundary: This would complete the remainder of the currently unwinding path, not all OPEC+ voluntary cuts, and does not prove equivalent net barrels reach the market.

interpretation_limits: The 188 thousand barrels per day is a nominal quota-path adjustment, not guaranteed net barrels reaching the market
Compensation cuts, compliance, overproduction correction, inventories and Hormuz transport losses can offset the nominal relaxation
The official decision confirms the nominal path but not actual production, exports or delivered barrels
pending.impact_path: OPEC+ supply guidance -> Brent and WTI -> inflation expectations and sovereign yields -> dollar and equity valuation -> BTC and high-beta crypto; the active Hormuz shipping disruption can amplify every step.

scenarios.faster_phase_out_small_compensation: More net supply can lower oil and inflation premia and ease rate pressure; confirm with official quota tables, compensation plans, crude curves, breakevens, yields, the dollar, equities and BTC.
scenarios.expected_188_kbd_hike_but_constrained_fl: A consensus-sized paper increase may have limited effect when Hormuz disruption, compensation or capacity constraints prevent equivalent barrels reaching buyers.
scenarios.pause_reverse_or_larger_compensation: Less net supply can raise oil and inflation premia and tighten financial conditions; confirm the same evidence chain before drawing direction.
scenarios.larger_or_additional_tranche_acceleratio: An official move beyond the expected 188 thousand barrels per day can strengthen oil-downside and disinflation channels, but only if actual production and transport rise.
scenarios.ambiguous_statement: Treat as no signal until actual production guidance and market confirmation become clear.

pending.invalidation: Compensation, compliance, capacity or Hormuz transport constraints offset the nominal increase, actual output and exports fail to rise, and no persistent oil or cross-asset repricing follows.
pending.permitted_use: Raise monitoring sensitivity and compare confirmed cross-asset reactions with the stated scenarios.
pending.prohibited_use: Do not use this alert alone to place an order or change position size, leverage, stops or live-trading permissions.

verified_facts: The BOJ held the overnight call rate near 1.0 percent by an 8 to 1 vote on 31 July
One member preferred 1.25 percent
The BOJ retained a further-hike path and judged inflation risks tilted to the upside
pending.impact_path: A broader earlier-hike preference -> stronger JPY and higher JGB yields -> carry-trade deleveraging -> global high-beta volatility -> BTC and crypto liquidations.

scenarios.broader_hawkish_distribution: Carry-risk rises only if JPY strengthens, JGB yields rise and global high-beta assets weaken together.
scenarios.isolated_dissent_or_softer_language: The carry-risk premium may fade if the dissent remains isolated and JPY or JGB markets do not confirm.

pending.invalidation: The opinions show no broader urgency to hike, or JPY and JGB yields fail to confirm the hawkish interpretation.
pending.permitted_use: Increase attention to JPY, JGB yields and cross-asset deleveraging confirmation.
pending.prohibited_use: Do not use this alert alone to place an order or change position size, leverage, stops or live-trading permissions.

verified_facts: July ISM manufacturing is due 3 August at 22:00 Asia/Shanghai
June JOLTS is due 4 August at 22:00 Asia/Shanghai
July ISM services is due 5 August at 22:00 Asia/Shanghai
The July employment report follows on 7 August at 20:30 Asia/Shanghai
pending.impact_path: Activity, employment and price evidence -> Federal Reserve path and Treasury yields -> dollar and equity valuation -> BTC and high-beta crypto.

scenarios.strong_growth_high_prices: Higher yields and a stronger dollar can pressure duration and crypto, unless risk appetite clearly dominates.
scenarios.weak_growth_high_prices: Stagflation is the most adverse combination for broad risk assets; require sustained yield, dollar and equity confirmation.
scenarios.weak_growth_cooling_prices: Easing expectations may lower yields, but a growth scare can offset the benefit.
scenarios.mixed_sequence: Do not extrapolate the first release; wait for the sequence and revisions.

pending.invalidation: The releases are internally mixed and do not create a persistent change in Treasury yields, the dollar, equities or crypto market structure.
pending.permitted_use: Use the sequence to update scenario probabilities and confirmation thresholds ahead of the employment report.
pending.prohibited_use: Do not use a single headline or this queue item alone to place an order or change position size, leverage, stops or live-trading permissions.

verified_facts: The Federal Reserve schedules SLOOS for 3 August at 2:00 p.m. ET, or 4 August at 02:00 Asia/Shanghai
The April SLOOS reported tighter C&I lending standards and tighter standards across all nondepository financial institution loan categories
Governor Lisa Cook is scheduled to discuss the economic outlook on 5 August at 4:05 p.m. ET, or 6 August at 04:05 Asia/Shanghai
Cook said on 15 July that elevated inflation concerned her more than employment risks at that time
pending.impact_path: Bank credit standards and post-FOMC communication -> growth and inflation expectations -> Treasury yields, credit spreads and the dollar -> equities and liquidity-sensitive BTC and crypto.

scenarios.tighter_credit_hawkish_speech: A joint rise in credit stress, yields and the dollar with weaker equities and BTC is the clearest adverse risk-asset configuration.
scenarios.easier_credit_softer_speech: Lower yields and tighter credit spreads may support risk assets, but verify that the move is not driven by an acute growth scare.
scenarios.offsetting_or_repeated_messages: Treat as no new signal if SLOOS and the speech offset each other, repeat priced information or lack persistent cross-asset confirmation.

pending.invalidation: Credit conditions do not materially shift, Cook repeats already-priced guidance, or Treasury yields, credit spreads, the dollar, equities and BTC fail to confirm a common regime change.
pending.permitted_use: Raise monitoring sensitivity around the two low-liquidity windows and update macro scenario probabilities only after cross-asset confirmation.
pending.prohibited_use: Do not use this queue item alone to place an order or change position size, leverage, stops or live-trading permissions.

verified_facts: USTR implemented 10 or 12.5 percent Section 301 tariffs on most imports from 60 economies from 24 July at 12:01 Asia/Shanghai, with specified product exemptions
The in-transit grace period ended 28 July at 12:01 Asia/Shanghai
USTR states the 60 trading partners account for 99.4 percent of U.S. imports
Separate 50 percent additional duties on specified Canadian goods take effect 19 August at 12:01 Asia/Shanghai, while energy, potash, Section 232 goods and specified other products are excluded
Canada's prime minister said Canada would intensify negotiations and take necessary measures to support its economy, but no new specific retaliation list for the 19 August action was verified
pending.impact_path: Broad tariffs and retaliation risk -> import costs, inflation expectations and growth -> Treasury curve and dollar -> global equities, commodity currencies and liquidity-sensitive BTC and crypto.

scenarios.inflation_and_retaliation: Higher breakevens, yields and the dollar with weaker equities and BTC would confirm a tighter-financial-conditions shock.
scenarios.growth_dominant_shock: Lower yields with weaker equities can signal growth damage; the dollar and BTC response must determine whether easing expectations or risk aversion dominates.
scenarios.negotiation_pause_or_exemptions: A suspension, negotiated rollback or broader exemptions can reduce the tariff risk premium if confirmed across CAD, yields, equities and BTC.
scenarios.no_persistent_repricing: Treat implementation as already priced when cross-asset moves do not persist.

pending.invalidation: The tariffs are materially suspended or withdrawn, exemptions expand enough to reduce macro transmission, retaliation does not occur and markets show no persistent cross-asset repricing.
pending.permitted_use: Raise monitoring sensitivity for retaliation, inflation expectations and the 19 August implementation window, then update scenario probabilities only after cross-asset confirmation.
pending.prohibited_use: Do not infer an immediate bearish trade from the tariff headline alone or change orders, position size, leverage, stops or live-trading permissions from this alert.

confidence.basis: The release time and 9-to-3 vote are official; directional interpretation remains conditional on the breadth of hawkish views, intervening data and cross-asset confirmation.

window.event: Minutes of the 28-29 July FOMC meeting

verified_facts: The July FOMC maintained the 3.50 to 3.75 percent federal funds target range by a 9-to-3 vote
Hammack, Kashkari and Logan preferred a 25 basis point rate increase
The statement described economic activity as solid and inflation as elevated, partly due to supply shocks including energy
The minutes are scheduled for 19 August at 2:00 p.m. ET, or 20 August at 02:00 Asia/Shanghai
pending.impact_path: Breadth of hike or higher-for-longer support -> Treasury yields and dollar -> equity duration and liquidity conditions -> BTC and high-beta crypto.

scenarios.hawkish_views_broader_than_three_dissent: A broader concern about inflation, tariffs or energy would raise tightening risk if yields and the dollar rise while equities and BTC weaken.
scenarios.dissents_isolated_growth_concern_broader: If the three dissenters appear isolated and more members emphasize employment or growth risk, the hawkish tail may fade, subject to current-data confirmation.
scenarios.minutes_overtaken_by_new_data: Give greater weight to intervening employment and CPI evidence when it materially changes the July information set.
scenarios.mixed_cross_asset_response: Treat as no actionable direction when yields, the dollar, equities and BTC do not confirm the same regime.

pending.invalidation: Intervening data clearly supersede the July debate, the minutes show no broader inclination to hike, or market reactions fail to persist across yields, the dollar, equities and BTC.
pending.permitted_use: Raise monitoring sensitivity for the 02:00 Asia/Shanghai release and compare the breadth of policy views with intervening data and cross-asset confirmation.
pending.prohibited_use: Do not trade from the historical vote count or minutes headline alone, and do not change orders, position size, leverage, stops or live-trading permissions from this alert.

confidence.basis: All three release windows are published by BLS or the Census Bureau; direction depends on the joint inflation-demand pattern and cross-asset confirmation.

verified_facts: July CPI is scheduled for 12 August at 20:30 Asia/Shanghai
July PPI is scheduled for 13 August at 20:30 Asia/Shanghai
July retail and food-services sales are scheduled for 14 August at 20:30 Asia/Shanghai
June retail and food-services sales rose 0.2 percent month over month and 6.7 percent year over year, with the prior monthly gain revised upward
pending.impact_path: Inflation and consumer-demand sequence -> Federal Reserve path and Treasury curve -> dollar and equity valuation -> BTC, crypto funding and liquidation risk.

scenarios.hot_inflation_strong_demand: Higher yields and a stronger dollar with weaker equities and BTC would confirm a tighter-financial-conditions shock.
scenarios.hot_inflation_weak_demand: A stagflation mix is adverse when breakevens stay high, real growth expectations fall and risk assets weaken together.
scenarios.cool_inflation_weak_demand: Lower yields can support duration and crypto, but an acute growth scare may dominate; require equities, credit and BTC confirmation.
scenarios.mixed_sequence_or_revisions: Do not extrapolate the first headline; wait for components, revisions and persistent cross-asset agreement.

pending.invalidation: The sequence is internally offsetting or fails to cause a persistent change in Treasury yields, the dollar, equities, credit conditions or crypto market structure.
pending.permitted_use: Raise monitoring sensitivity across the three releases and update macro-regime probabilities only after components, revisions and cross-asset confirmation are assessed.
pending.prohibited_use: Do not use a single headline or this queue item alone to place an order or change position size, leverage, stops or live-trading permissions.

confidence.basis: The dates and theme are confirmed by the Kansas City Fed; the agenda, speakers, exact times and policy direction remain unconfirmed.

verified_facts: The 2026 Jackson Hole Economic Policy Symposium will take place from 27 to 29 August
The official theme is Financial Innovation: Implications for Payments and Policy
The agenda, speakers and exact speech times have not yet been published
pending.impact_path: Central-bank policy communication -> global yields and dollar -> equity duration and liquidity -> BTC and high-beta crypto; concrete payment, stablecoin, tokenization or digital-asset policy content can also reprice regulatory expectations directly.

scenarios.hawkish_macro_message: Higher global yields and a stronger dollar with weaker equities and BTC would confirm tighter financial conditions.
scenarios.dovish_or_disinflation_message: Lower yields may support risk assets, but verify that the move is not an acute growth scare.
scenarios.constructive_payments_policy: Specific, implementable support for payment innovation, stablecoins or tokenization may improve crypto policy expectations only when the content and affected asset classes are explicit.
scenarios.restrictive_or_ambiguous_policy: Do not infer a crypto direction from the theme alone; wait for exact language, scope and market confirmation.

pending.invalidation: The agenda contains no market-relevant policy communication, remarks repeat already-priced guidance, or yields, the dollar, equities and crypto do not show persistent confirmation.
pending.permitted_use: Monitor for the agenda, named speakers and exact times, then update macro and digital-payments scenario probabilities only after the actual remarks and cross-asset response are verified.
pending.prohibited_use: Do not treat the conference theme as a crypto endorsement or restriction, and do not place orders or change position size, leverage, stops or live-trading permissions from this alert alone.

confidence.basis: BEA and Census schedules independently confirm the simultaneous 8:30 a.m. ET releases; market direction depends on the joint data pattern, components and revisions.

verified_facts: Second-quarter GDP second estimate and corporate profits are due 26 August at 20:30 Asia/Shanghai
July personal income, outlays and PCE are due at the same time
July advance durable-goods orders are also due at the same time
The advance baseline is 1.5 percent annualized real GDP growth, while June durable-goods orders rose 0.3 percent and orders excluding transportation rose 0.6 percent
pending.impact_path: Growth, profits, inflation, household demand and capital-expenditure evidence -> Federal Reserve path and Treasury curve -> dollar, credit and equity valuation -> BTC, crypto funding and liquidation risk.

scenarios.strong_growth_orders_hot_pce: Higher yields and a stronger dollar with weaker duration assets and BTC would confirm tighter financial conditions.
scenarios.weak_growth_orders_hot_pce: A stagflation configuration is adverse when breakevens stay elevated, growth expectations fall and equities, credit and BTC weaken together.
scenarios.weak_growth_orders_cool_pce: Lower yields may support duration and crypto, but an acute growth or profit scare can dominate; require credit and equity confirmation.
scenarios.conflicting_components_or_revisions: Separate volatile transportation and defense orders, core capital goods and GDP revision sources before drawing any direction.

pending.invalidation: The reports offset one another or fail to create a persistent change in yields, the dollar, credit, equities or crypto market structure.
pending.permitted_use: Increase monitoring sensitivity for the simultaneous release and update regime probabilities only after separating components, revisions and cross-asset confirmation.
pending.prohibited_use: Do not react to the first headline alone or place orders or change position size, leverage, stops or live-trading permissions from this queue item.

confidence.basis: The Treasury quarterly-refunding page confirms the 3:00 p.m. ET Monday financing-estimate slot and the 8:30 a.m. ET Wednesday refunding slot, while market direction remains conditional on the amounts, maturity mix, TGA path and buyback details.

verified_facts: Treasury schedules the next financing-estimate release for 3 August in the 3:00 p.m. ET Monday slot, or 4 August at 03:00 Asia/Shanghai
Treasury schedules the next quarterly-refunding documents for 5 August in the 8:30 a.m. ET Wednesday slot, or 5 August at 20:30 Asia/Shanghai
The May baseline estimated 671 billion dollars of privately held net marketable borrowing for July through September and a 950 billion dollar end-September cash balance
pending.impact_path: Borrowing need, maturity mix, TGA path and buybacks -> bill and coupon supply, market liquidity and Treasury yields -> dollar and equity valuation -> BTC, crypto funding and liquidation risk.

scenarios.higher_borrowing_more_duration_or_higher: Higher coupon supply, less supportive buybacks or a higher cash target can tighten liquidity and raise term premium; require higher yields or a stronger dollar with weaker equities and BTC for confirmation.
scenarios.lower_borrowing_shorter_mix_more_buyback: Lower duration supply or a more supportive liquidity path can ease term premium, but distinguish benign technical relief from weaker growth or fiscal-receipt deterioration.
scenarios.mixed_headlines: Separate total borrowing, bill-versus-coupon composition, TGA assumptions, auction sizes and buyback operations; do not assign direction from the headline amount alone.

pending.invalidation: Amounts and issuance structure remain near the May baseline or cross-asset moves fail to persist across Treasury yields, the dollar, equities and crypto market structure.
pending.permitted_use: Raise monitoring sensitivity across the two-release sequence and update liquidity-regime probabilities only after the financing amount, maturity composition, TGA path, buybacks and cross-asset response are verified.
pending.prohibited_use: Do not use the May baseline or either first headline alone to place orders or change position size, leverage, stops or live-trading permissions.

confidence.basis: IMO, OFAC and UKMTO/JMIC provide independent incident, sanctions and operational evidence. The existence and severity of the risk environment are well supported, while the next directional market move remains conditional.

verified_facts: IMO reports 62 confirmed regional maritime incidents and 17 confirmed seafarer fatalities as of 27 July 2026
IMO says around 20,000 seafarers are affected and its evacuation plan is currently paused
UKMTO/JMIC assessed the regional maritime threat as SEVERE on 7 July, reported recurring GNSS interference and described commercial transit routes that were still operating at that dated baseline
OFAC published Iran-related sanctions actions on 29 and 30 July covering shipping, petroleum, finance, aviation and military-support networks
An OFAC designation narrative says a named transit-insurance entity accepted bitcoin and other digital assets; this is entity-specific evidence and not a broad prohibition on crypto assets
pending.impact_path: New attack, transit disruption, insurance withdrawal or sanctions expansion -> oil and freight shock -> inflation expectations, sovereign yields and dollar -> equities and credit -> BTC weekend gaps, funding stress and liquidation cascades; named digital-asset sanctions exposure can separately affect specific counterparties and flows.

scenarios.physical_escalation_or_transit_deteriora: Oil and freight premia can rise while risk assets weaken; the yield and dollar response may differ between inflation shock and flight-to-safety regimes, so require crude, gold, yields, dollar, equities, BTC funding and liquidation confirmation.
scenarios.verified_safe_passage_or_sustained_trans: Energy and insurance premia may ease, but treat relief as actionable only if official operational data and cross-asset repricing persist.
scenarios.sanctions_or_compliance_expansion_withou: Assess named entities, addresses, intermediaries and jurisdictions; do not generalize an entity-specific bitcoin reference into a market-wide crypto ban or direction.
scenarios.stale_or_unconfirmed_report: Do not react until a second authoritative source or primary operational notice confirms the event.

pending.invalidation: Official sources verify sustained transit normalization, the evacuation constraint is lifted, incident and insurance conditions materially improve, and oil, freight, dollar, equities and crypto cease pricing an elevated risk premium.
pending.permitted_use: Maintain five-minute official-source monitoring, raise volatility and liquidity-risk sensitivity, and update regime probabilities only after source and cross-asset confirmation.
pending.prohibited_use: Do not trade an unverified report, infer broad crypto illegality from an entity-specific designation, or use this alert to place orders or change position size, leverage, stops or live-trading permissions.

confidence.basis: The operator, Kazakhstan's foreign ministry and AP independently confirm the attacks and route importance; CPC confirms loading resumed on 27 July, so current risk is recurrence rather than a verified ongoing shutdown.

verified_facts: CPC says ASIA and NISSOS IOS were struck by drones during loading on 19 July, causing a fire on ASIA and a loading halt without casualties or an oil spill
CPC says loading resumed on the evening of 19 July but NELSA was attacked during loading on 20 July, causing another fire, crew evacuation and another loading stop
CPC says its pipeline transports more than two thirds of Kazakhstan's export crude, while AP estimates about 80 percent
CPC's official 2026 release list says oil lifting resumed on 27 July with two tankers berthed at single-point moorings
pending.impact_path: Repeated tanker or terminal attack -> CPC loading interruption, insurance and Black Sea freight shock -> crude supply and Brent risk premium -> inflation expectations, yields and dollar -> equities, credit and BTC; simultaneous Hormuz disruption can amplify the supply shock nonlinearly.

scenarios.new_attack_or_loading_suspension: Treat as renewed supply-risk escalation only after CPC or another authoritative operational source confirms the event; require crude curves, freight, yields, dollar, equities and BTC to confirm persistence.
scenarios.sustained_loading_and_falling_freight_pr: Continued operation without further attacks can reduce the risk premium, but it does not invalidate the broader Black Sea conflict risk by itself.
scenarios.physical_disruption_offset_by_supply_els: Separate actual lost CPC barrels from OPEC+ nominal quota changes, inventories and alternative routes before assigning an inflation or BTC direction.
scenarios.unattributed_or_conflicting_claims: Do not assign responsibility or market direction from belligerent statements alone; prioritize operator status and independently verified physical effects.

pending.invalidation: CPC loadings remain sustained, no further tanker or terminal attacks are verified, insurance and freight conditions normalize, and crude and cross-asset markets stop carrying a material recurrence premium.
pending.permitted_use: Raise monitoring sensitivity for CPC operator notices, tanker attacks, loading status, insurance and freight changes, and update energy-risk probabilities only after physical and cross-asset confirmation.
pending.prohibited_use: Do not describe the terminal as currently shut based on the 19-20 July events, assign attack responsibility from one side's claim, or use this alert to place orders or change position size, leverage, stops or live-trading permissions.

confidence.basis: The President and White House press secretary publicly signaled continued military pressure, and Axios independently reports active consideration of Iranian energy targets. No final strike order or completed new U.S. strike was confirmed at the scan time.

verified_facts: AP directly quotes President Trump on 31 July saying the United States will keep hitting Iran very hard
AP directly quotes the White House press secretary saying Iran will continue to pay until it enters meaningful talks
Axios reports that attacks on Iranian energy targets are being seriously considered for the next few days while explicitly stating that no final orders have been issued

AP reports that Iran's Revolutionary Guard claimed attacks on two more tankers and that Kuwait intercepted drones, but this scan did not obtain complete second-source operational confirmation for those immediate battle-damage claims
The pre-existing U.S. naval blockade, repeated attacks on shipping and Strait of Hormuz disruption provide a verified escalation baseline
pending.impact_path: Confirmed U.S. energy-target strike or Iranian retaliation -> oil production, refining, export and shipping risk -> crude and freight spike -> inflation expectations, yields and dollar -> equities, credit and BTC weekend gap, funding and liquidation stress.

scenarios.final_order_and_energy_strikes_confirmed: Treat as the highest escalation case; distinguish physical output or export loss from rhetoric, then require crude curves, freight, gold, yields, dollar, equities, BTC funding and liquidations to confirm persistence.
scenarios.limited_military_strikes_without_energy_: Risk-off may be smaller or short-lived if energy flows remain stable; do not transfer the energy-target scenario mechanically.
scenarios.no_order_and_negotiation_progress: A verified pause, talks or safe-passage arrangement can compress oil and weekend risk premia, subject to transport and cross-asset confirmation.
scenarios.iranian_retaliation_or_regional_spillove: Confirmed tanker, base, refinery or Gulf-state infrastructure damage can produce nonlinear escalation even without a new U.S. energy strike.
scenarios.rhetoric_or_unverified_claims_only: Maintain P0 monitoring but do not assign trade direction until a primary operational source and a second independent source confirm physical effects.

pending.invalidation: The White House or Defense Department confirms no strike order, diplomacy produces a durable stand-down, no new physical attacks are verified, and shipping, energy and cross-asset risk premia normalize.
pending.permitted_use: Keep five-minute official-source monitoring active and raise weekend volatility and liquidity-risk sensitivity; update regime probabilities only after strike orders, physical effects and cross-asset confirmation are verified.
pending.prohibited_use: Do not report a final strike order that has not been issued, trade on anonymous-source planning alone, or use this alert to place orders or change position size, leverage, stops or live-trading permissions.

confidence.basis: AP directly attributes the maritime details to UKMTO and the regional damage statement to Kuwait's Defense Ministry. IMO's official incident list remains at its 27 July baseline, so the new incidents are not yet incorporated in its count.

verified_facts: UKMTO reported that an unknown projectile struck a tanker about 11 nautical miles northeast of Limah, Oman, damaging its engine room; no casualties were reported
UKMTO reported a large splash and explosion close to another tanker about 21 nautical miles northwest of Khasab on 1 August; no casualties were reported
Kuwait's Defense Ministry said drones struck several vital facilities, including a government structure in the north, with material damage but no casualties
IMO's public confirmed-incident list still shows 62 incidents and 17 seafarer fatalities as of 27 July and has not yet incorporated the new reports

AP cited Lloyd's List Intelligence data showing Strait of Hormuz transits fell from 82 ships in 13-19 July to 39 ships in 20-26 July, a decline of about 52.4 percent; some passage continued, so this is not evidence of literal zero transit
No final U.S. order or executed strike on Iranian energy targets was confirmed at the scan time

market_confirmation.source: Binance public spot and USD-M perpetual APIs
market_confirmation.assessment: Mixed spot performance, slightly positive funding, stable open interest and stablecoin quotes near par do not confirm an acute liquidation cascade or persistent cross-asset risk-off regime; this is a single-venue snapshot.

pending.impact_path: Repeated tanker and Gulf-facility attacks -> transit avoidance, insurance and freight shock or verified energy damage -> oil and inflation repricing -> yields and dollar plus equity and credit stress -> BTC weekend gaps, funding compression and liquidation risk.

scenarios.additional_ship_strike_or_transit_deteri: Escalation becomes more market-relevant if authoritative sources confirm more damage, abandonment, route closure, insurance withdrawal or freight spikes; require oil, gold, yields, dollar, equities and crypto structure to confirm persistence.
scenarios.confirmed_energy_output_or_export_loss: Treat as the strongest inflationary supply-shock branch, but measure actual lost barrels and duration before assigning direction to yields, dollar or BTC.
scenarios.no_further_incidents_and_flows_stable: Risk premium may fade if passage continues, damage remains contained and insurance or freight conditions normalize; require sustained operational and market evidence.
scenarios.separate_us_strike_order_confirmation: A confirmed U.S. energy-target order or strike is a distinct escalation and must not be inferred from the tanker or Kuwait incidents.

pending.invalidation: No further attacks are verified, the damaged tanker remains operational or is safely recovered, shipping and energy flows continue, insurance and freight premia normalize, and crypto plus broader risk markets do not develop persistent stress.
pending.permitted_use: Raise immediate volatility, liquidity and weekend-gap sensitivity and update scenario probabilities only after operational damage, energy-flow effects and cross-asset confirmation are verified.
pending.prohibited_use: Do not infer a U.S. energy strike order, major oil-supply loss or fixed crypto direction from these incidents, and do not use this alert to place orders or change position size, leverage, stops or live-trading permissions.

confidence.basis: Official Saudi coalition and regional statements establish vessel-protection measures, a commercial-vessel attack and military response; independent ship tracking confirms selective reversals, while AP reports an eighth rerouting claim.

verified_facts: The Houthis announced a maritime embargo against Saudi-linked shipping on 20 July

Saudi Arabia's Foreign Ministry officially rejected the Houthi allegations and the claimed blockade rationale, while the United Nations expressed concern over threats to Saudi Arabia and freedom of navigation

Lloyd's List and MarineTraffic analysis reported by the Washington Post identified seven vessels that reversed course, including cargo and oil vessels, while many other ships continued through Bab el-Mandeb
AP reported on 1 August that the Houthi military spokesperson claimed eight Saudi ships had rerouted around the Cape of Good Hope
